html:
G'oya

Avval har yo'nalish va har oy uchun chiptalar soni. Keyin har oyni o'sha yo'nalishning o'tgan yilidagi xuddi shu oyi bilan juftlash kerak. Nozik joy shu: o'tgan yilning shu oyi natijadagi 12 qator oldingi qator emas, chunki sotuvsiz oylar natijada yo'q. Shuning uchun oylik jadvalni o'zi bilan "oy boshi minus bir yil" sharti bo'yicha LEFT JOIN qilamiz.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH m AS (
  SELECT route, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', sold_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS tickets
  FROM tickets
  WHERE returned = 0
  GROUP BY route, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', sold_at) AS DATE)
)
SELECT cur.route, TO_CHAR(cur.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, cur.tickets,
       ROUND(100.0 * (cur.tickets - prev.tickets) / prev.tickets, 1) AS yoy_pct
FROM m cur
LEFT JOIN m prev ON prev.route = cur.route
                AND prev.month_start = CAST(cur.month_start - INTERVAL '1 year' AS DATE)
ORDER BY cur.route, cur.month_start

Jufti topilmasa prev.tickets NULL va foiz ham NULL. Namunada Toshkent-Samarqand 2024-03 da 3 ta chipta, 2023-03 da 2 ta (uchinchisi qaytarilgan): 50.0. 2024-05 uchun 2023-05 yo'q, natija NULL.

Tuzoqlar

LAG(tickets, 12) 12 ta oldingi qatorni oladi, 12 oy oldingisini emas. Sotuvsiz oylar natijada yo'q va siljish noto'g'ri oyga tushadi:

Noto'g'riWITH m AS (
  SELECT route, strftime('%Y-%m', sold_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS tickets
  FROM tickets
  WHERE returned = 0
  GROUP BY route, strftime('%Y-%m', sold_at)
)
SELECT route, month, tickets,
       ROUND(100.0 * (tickets - LAG(tickets, 12) OVER (PARTITION BY route ORDER BY month))
             / LAG(tickets, 12) OVER (PARTITION BY route ORDER BY month), 1) AS yoy_pct
FROM m
ORDER BY route, month

JOIN da yo'nalishni unutsangiz, Samarqand chiptalari Buxoro chiptalari bilan solishtiriladi. Qaytarilgan chiptalarni WHERE da olib tashlang: faqat qaytarilganlari bo'lgan oy shunda natijadan ham, keyingi yilning "o'tgan yili"dan ham yo'qoladi.

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da oy boshi date(sold_at, 'start of month'), bir yil oldingi oy date(month_start, '-1 year'):

Faqat SQLiteWITH m AS (
  SELECT route, date(sold_at, 'start of month') AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS tickets
  FROM tickets
  WHERE returned = 0
  GROUP BY route, date(sold_at, 'start of month')
)
SELECT cur.route, strftime('%Y-%m', cur.month_start) AS month, cur.tickets,
       ROUND(100.0 * (cur.tickets - prev.tickets) / prev.tickets, 1) AS yoy_pct
FROM m cur
LEFT JOIN m prev ON prev.route = cur.route
                AND prev.month_start = date(cur.month_start, '-1 year')
ORDER BY cur.route, cur.month_start

Oy boshidan bir yil ayirish xavfsiz. 29-fevraldan bir yil ayirilsa, bazalar har xil sana beradi, oyning 1-kunida esa bunday muammo yo'q.
